sourceNote: Printed page 188. A framed two-column sample CV ("A Sample CV") for the fictional "Muhammad Abbas Atif": the left column holds the portrait, Contact and Languages; the right column holds Summary, Skill Highlights (two columns of three), Experience, Education, Certifications and References. All details are specimen data invented for the textbook (the address, phone number and email shown are the specimen text of the CV). The sections are given here in reading order of the right column first, then the left column. A cartoon portrait is not reproduced. Border lines, a pink corner flag, the watermark and the "Whatsapp" strip are excluded. The page number 188 is printed in a diamond at the foot.
